 Prince Mishra joins Zee 5 as Senior Vice President – Creative
 by 
 MN4U Bureau 
 November 6, 2026 
 in 
 Media 
 Reading Time: 1 min read
 A 
 A 
 A 
 A 
 Reset 
 Share Share Share Share 
 Mumbai: Prince Mishra has been appointed as Senior Vice President – Creative at Zee 5, bringing over 14 years of experience across films, advertising, television, radio and OTT. In his new role, Mishra will focus on strengthening the platform’s brand proposition, deepening consumer affinity and building stronger audience connections through its content portfolio.
 Mishra joins Zee 5 from Prime Video, where he most recently worked across creative strategy, brand building and content marketing. His experience includes developing and executing content launches and integrated campaigns, spanning multiple entertainment and media formats.
 At Zee 5, he will be responsible for translating the platform’s diverse content portfolio into compelling consumer experiences and strengthening its brand connect as it moves into its next phase of growth. His appointment comes as the platform continues to focus on building its brand proposition and enhancing audience engagement.
